newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank leads Estonian stocks rise.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank leads Estonian stocks rise.

text.p: The Estonian stock market index closed 6.59 percent higher on Tuesday, helped by big gains in market leader Hansapank and record official list trade of 50.3 million kroons, traders said.
Hansapank, the most heavily traded stock with turnover of 19.1 million kroons, closed up 13.25 kroons at 127.25.
Dealers said an announcement that the bank would be traded on the Frankfurt stock exchange was the key reason for its rise.

"The listing in Frankfurt is an outstanding thing. This is a proper bourse and Hansapank is the first company to have a quotation other than in Tallinn and Helsinki," Tonu Vanajuur, a dealer from Forexpank, told Reuters.
Some Western investors were sceptical that the market rally could go much further.
"My personal view is that this rise will not continue for too long," the dealer said, noting that Hansapank closing price was four kroons lower than the 131 kroon high it registered during the day.
Other shares followed Hansapank's rise with Forexpank also well traded on a record volume of 15 million kroons. It closed at 81.00 kroons versus 76.65.
The fourth largest bank Tallinna Pank had volume of seven million kroons and closed higher at 46.36 kroons against 40.30.

"Investors are probably optimistic on the next year profit. There are no other explanations for the rise," Charlie Viikberg, dealer from Estonian Savings bank, said, speaking about Tallinna Pank and Forexpank.
The over-the-counter market was led by plastics maker Norma which had eight million kroons of volume and closed two kroons higher at 35.75.
The total volume of the free market was 11.5 million kroons.
